reviewed_scope: Read-only source review53->54; no Godot/runtime tests and no game edits

findings.title: Stale half-sword state disables RMB mace after switching from half-sword
findings.trigger: Equip sword; X enables half-sword; select mace through ordinary preview_weapons._sword_prototype_weapon; hold RMB.
findings.cause: set_weapon and set_selected preserve _half_sword. New _right_hand_weapon54 rejects all _half_sword, so mace stays blocking and RMB does not count as swing. Existing _solve_arm also sees this stale flag and selects half-sword IK.
findings.scope: Stale flag existed before candidate, but it now prevents the newly requested RMB mace behavior.
findings.suggestion: Clear invalid half-sword mode when the weapon actually changes from sword to a non-sword, preserving valid sword half-sword and LMB dynamics. Helper-only relaxation leaves half-sword IK on mace.

source_conclusions.lmb_only: With RMB false, _swing_held54 reduces exactly to _hold_left and the new smoothing branch is false. Existing LMB input branch/coefficients are unchanged.
source_conclusions.rmb_sword_mace: When shield and half-sword false, RMB leaves guard, uses shared target/torque/IK/swing phase and damage. Right-hand choice already exists.
source_conclusions.release: RMB release starts180ms existing momentum coast only when LMB not held; press cancels coast. Existing _sword_coasting31 excludes held RMB, so LMB release while RMB remains held does not force coasting.
source_conclusions.shield: _right_hand_weapon54 false with shield; existing shield control and _blocking values preserved.
source_conclusions.other_weapons: Helper false for axe/sledge/spear; phase/chest/damage helpers reduce to previous LMB conditions.
source_conclusions.half_sword: Sword half-sword helper false, preserving existing RMB guard; stale switch edge is listed.
source_conclusions.switch_drop_menu: Existing weapon switch resets coast/omega/contact histories; drops clear both held flags; inactive physics clears missed-release flags.
source_conclusions.near_parallel_smoothing: New normalized-lerp guard is restricted to eligible RMB-only and dot>0.9999. LMB-only path and all smoothing coefficients preserved; runtime stability not independently tested.

limits: Review is source-only; it does not certify mirrored arm motion, natural contacts or real-input runtime.
Finding requires native regression verification after any repair; no runtime was started here.
